'''Hawj''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] diplomat and author from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thoran]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Hawj pursued a business alliance with [[Skydove Freight]]. An aspiring novelist, he planned to base a [[Holobook/Legends|holonovel]] on his family and [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
